reviews.text: Dr. Striekert is simply the best veterinarian there is in San Antonio. She is extremely knowledgeable, patient and professional! Our fur babies Trooper and Duchess trust and love the staff as well.
They always help accommodate and for the this level of care at a great price!
Dr. Strickert and her staff are awesome. Very caring and compassionate. Dr. Strickert has taken care of all of our furbabies for over 30 years.
Loving caring, very professional, best veterinarian in San Antonio, make your appointment today, to receive the best care for your pet!!!
Love Dr. Julie and all the staff. Always easy to make an appointment and prices are reasonable.

What a caring, gentle demeanor the doctor has! We just love her direct and to the point opinions about what is best for our pups!
We Highly recommend this Vet Hospital & office 😊 …
Always takes good care of my fur babies and handles them with care and concern. Wouldn't go to any other vet. Wonderful customer service and follow up calls and visits!

I'll never take my cat anywhere else! The staff and vet are the absolute best. They will ensure they take care of your fur baby and do it on a budget. I highly recommend this vet office if you're looking for a perfect place to take your fur baby. I take my cat there quarterly because unfortunately my cat is an indoor and outdoor cat and he gets in all sorts of trouble. They have accommodated me time after time for emergencies during the day and they don't have any availability. They have seen him in between their appointments just so they can take him in. They're so awesome. Can't rave about this place enough.

I’ve gone there with an emergency 3 different times with 3 different animals and I was turned away 3 times. And now looking through the comments I can see that other parents that were going through similar situations with their animals were treated. You should be ashamed. The lady with the short hair in the front is who turned me away. Wouldn’t even allow my dogs to get checked out. Just told me there was nothing they could do with a smirk on her face and showed me the door. If I could give 0 stars I would!
